City of Encinitas
City Council - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, JANUARY 27, 2016 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a "WHITE" speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two (2) Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
PROCEDURES FOR PUBLIC HEARINGS ON APPEALS (ITEM #10A): New information such as documents, exhibits, letters, photos, charts, diagrams, videos, etc., WILL NOT be considered by the Board if presented at this meeting. All material must have been submitted to the City Clerk no less than 7 calendar days prior to this hearing
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a "PINK" speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the January 13, 2016 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2016-01-27 Item 8A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants.
2016-01-27 Item 8B Warrants
8C.
Adoption of City Council Ordinance No. 2016-03, which, if adopted, would amend Encinitas Municipal Code (EMC) Chapter 2.16 titled, Campaign Regulations, to remove time limits for signs displaying political or other noncommercial messages, whereby the display of such signs is permitted at all times. Project No. 15-282 POD. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Adopt Ordinance No. 2016-03 titled, "An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas amending Chapter 2.16, Campaign Regulations, of the Encinitas Municipal Code."
2016-01-27 Item 8C Adoption of Ordinance 2016-03 Campaign Regulations
8D.
Santa Fe Drive North Sidewalk Improvements Project (CS07B). Contact Person: Associate Civil Engineer Kellar
1) Authorize the Public Works Director to award contracts for construction specialists, inspections, the purchase and installation of landscape materials, and other contracts, as necessary to complete the project; and 2) Authorize an increase in the not-to-exceed project budget to $993,948, to be expended from monies already allocated to the project.
2016-01-27 Item 8D Santa Fe Drive North Sidewalk
8E.
Authorize the purchase of a Pierce Arrow Triple Combination Pumper fire engine, as the recommended replacement for a 2006 American LaFrance Pumper (Engine #FM 247), and authorize lease financing to fund the purchase. Contact Person: Acting Fire Chief Stein
1) Authorize the sole source purchase of a Pierce Arrow Triple Combination Pumper, in conformity with the proposal submitted by Pierce Manufacturing, via the immediate issuance of a City of Encinitas Purchase Order. A sole source purchase is recommended to maintain compatibility with current front line engines for both operators and personnel; 2) Authorize staff to pre-pay for the purchase of the unit within 15 days of the issuance of the Purchase Order; 3)Authorize staff to seek long-term financing for the unit from Pinnacle Public Finance, on a negotiated basis, and to return to Council with the financing proposal and related documentation for Council approval; 4) Adopt Resolution 2016-06, titled "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2015-16 Budget", to increase the budget by $115,000 from $525,000 to $655,000 for the purchase of the pumper, additional equipment to place the pumper in service and a 2% contingency; and 5) Adopt Resolution 2016-08, titled "A Resolution of the City of Encinitas Declaring its Intent to Issue Tax-Exempt Financing to be Used to Reimburse the City of Qualified Expenditures Prior to the Issuance of Such Financing."
2016-01-27 Item 8E Fire Apparatus Replacement
8F.
Adoption of Resolution Nos. 2016-14 and 2016-16 denying two appeals filed by Charles and Suzanne Quirk and Patricia Roskowski, and uphold the Planning and Building Department decision to approve and issue Building Permit Nos. 15-615 and 15-616. BUILDING PERMIT NOS.: 15-615 and 15-616; APPLICANT: Andrew Smith; APPELLANTS: Charles and Suzanne Quirk and Patricia Roskowski; APPEAL CASE NOS.: 15-268 (Quirk) and 15-273 (Roskowski); LOCATION: 2344 8th Street. Contact Person: Senior Planner Sapa'u
Adopt Resolution Nos. 2016-14 and 2016-16 pursuant to City Council actions taken on January 20, 2016.
2016-01-27 Item 8F Resolutions of Denial of Appeals Quirk & Roskowski
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Public hearing to consider an appeal of the Planning Commission's denial of the construction of a new vehicle towing operations and impound yard located at 601 Santa Fe Drive. CASE NUMBER: 15-152 MUP/DR/CDP; APPLICANT: San Dieguito Water District (SDWD) and Leucadia Towing; APPELLANT: Leucadia Towing, Inc.; LOCATION: 601 Santa Fe Drive (260-121-15). Contact Person: Associate Planner Mierau
Deny the appeal and adopt Resolution No. 2016-11 (Attachment CC-2) affirming the decision of the Planning Commission to deny the project.
2016-01-27 Item 10A Public Hearing - Appeal - Leucadia Towing
10B.
FY 2014-15 and FY 2015-16 Youth Commission Work Plans. Contact Person: Recreation Superintendent Gorham
1) Council receive a verbal report regarding the FY 2014-15 Youth Commission Work Plan outcomes; and 2) Council approve the proposed FY 2015-2016 Youth Commission Work Plan presented by Delilah Forrest, Chair.
2016-01-27 Item 10B Youth Commission Work Plan
10C.
Federal Legislation H.R. 3643 regarding Interim Facilities for Spent Nuclear Fuel. Contact Person: Sr. Management Analyst McSeveney
1) Receive the report; and 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2016-15 in support of H.R. 3643.
2016-01-27 Item 10C HR 3643 Spent Nuclear Fuel Storage
10D.
Public hearing to consider the introduction of draft City Council Ordinance No. 2016-01 to amend the City's Water Efficient Landscape Regulations (Encinitas Municipal Code Chapter 23.26) to comply with the State's updated Model Water Efficient Landscape Ordinance (MWELO), which provides for greater efforts at water conservation and requires much more efficient use of water in landscaping. Contact Person: Senior Planner II Kusiak
1) Consider the information in the Agenda Report; 2) Open the public hearing and receive and consider public testimony; and, 3) Introduce, with modifications as determined necessary, City Council Ordinance No. 2016-01, an Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California Amending Chapter 23.26 (Water Efficient Landscape Regulations) of the Encinitas Municipal Code to comply with the updated State MWELO. (Attachment A)
2016-01-27 Item 10D Water efficient landscape regulations
10E.
Stormwater Best Management Practice Design Manual. Contact Person: Environmental Programs Manager Steenblock
Adopt City Council Resolution 2015-82, approving the City of Encinitas Stormwater Best Management Practice (BMP) Design Manual and its inclusion as Chapter 7 of the Engineering Design Manual.
2016-01-27 Item 10E BMP Design Manual Update
2016-01-27 Item 10E BMP Design Manual Update Attachment 2 to the Agenda Report
10F.
Proposal for interim agreement for Pacific View site improvements. Contact Person: Pacific View Subcommittee - Deputy Mayor Shaffer and Council Member Kranz
The Subcommittee requests that the Council direct the City Manager to develop and execute a "Right of Entry" agreement, in consultation with the City Attorney, Keyser Marston, and the Subcommittee, to enable the Pacific View Alliance (Alliance) to begin clean up, maintenance and renovation activities on the Pacific View school site while negotiations on a long-term agreement move forward.
2016-01-27 Item 10F Pacific View Interim Agreement
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
11A.
Moonlight Beach Marine Safety Center update - Wave Uprush study. Contact Person: Associate Civil Engineer Kellar
Receive the project update.
2016-01-27 Item 11A Moonlight Beach Marine Safety Center Update_Part1
2016-01-27 Item 11A Moonlight Beach Marine Safety Center Update_Part2 optimized
2016-01-27 Item 11A Moonlight Beach Marine Safety Center Update_Part3
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM
12A.
Council Initiated Item from Deputy Mayor Shaffer regarding City Manager Performance Plan.
2016-01-27 Item 12A Deputy Mayor Shaffer Initiated Item

FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS ADDED BY COUNCIL MEMBERS

ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING WILL BE HELD ON FEBRUARY 10, 2015
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
